source: Metricool last 10 published + contact sheets in runs/metricool-tomorrow/style

house.structure: voz real o proceso + B-roll literal + outro de logo 2–3s. Nunca mezclar paleta entre clientes.
house.broll: Literal to the spoken line or nothing. Food/product close-ups when named. Clinic/shop B-roll when showing the place.
house.outro: Last 2–3s brand card. Do not put captions on the outro.

families.white_sentence: White sentence-case, black outline, lower third. Default Nate talking-head.
families.yellow_upper: YELLOW UPPERCASE, black outline; hook can sit at the top.
families.brand_color: White or brand-color captions matching logo (cyan, orange, pink, gold).
families.process_silent: No captions on process B-roll; logo outro only.
